etmc.cmd.host.done: Hosting! Invite link copied to your clipboard: send it to the friends you want in (it contains the secret). /etmc invite copies it again.
etmc.cmd.invite.copied: Invite link copied to your clipboard. Friends paste it into Direct Connect (or etmc → Join). It contains the secret: send it only to people you want in.
etmc.cmd.invite.none: No active host session to invite to. Use /etmc host first.
etmc.cmd.status.hosting: etmc hosting — your address %s, players %s (direct %s), game connections %s
etmc.cmd.status.joined: etmc joined — your address %s, players %s (direct %s), game connections %s
etmc.cmd.status.no_relay: The relay hasn't been reached yet.
etmc.config.no_server: No server address. Add `[etmc]\nserver = "ip:port"` to the config or fill the Server field.
etmc.connecting.now.hint: "Join now anyway" skips the wait (it may fail if the host isn't reachable yet).
etmc.connecting.title: Joining
etmc.error.no_native: etmc couldn't load its EasyTier library: %s
etmc.error.no_native_log: etmc couldn't load its EasyTier library (see the game log).
etmc.error.not_ready: the EasyTier network isn't ready yet (no route to the host so far)
etmc.error.status: couldn't read the EasyTier network status
etmc.gen.label: Label (optional)
etmc.gen.link_copied: Copied etmc:// link. It contains the secret: share it only with people you want in.
etmc.gen.need_relay: Add the host's relay: without one, joiners have no way to reach the host.
etmc.gen.no_network_name: Couldn't find network_name in the clipboard TOML.
etmc.gen.relay.hint: Relay (several: commas or spaces between them)
etmc.host.blocked.no_relay: Add a relay in Settings first: joiners reach you through it.
etmc.host.blocked.no_world: Open a singleplayer world first: etmc hosts the world you're playing.
etmc.host.failed: Joiners can't connect any more (%s). Stop and start hosting again from the etmc menu.
etmc.host.label: World label
etmc.host.lan_kept: Already opened to LAN? Game mode and cheats are kept.
etmc.host.need_secret: Enter a secret: without one, anyone who guesses the network name can join.
etmc.host.offline.warning: Anyone with your link can join under any name. Friends with real accounts start with a new inventory.
etmc.host.secret.hint: Secret: plain text, keep it random, never a real password
etmc.join.added: Added '%s' to Multiplayer. Leave this world, then join it from there (or Direct Connect %s). It stays valid until you leave the etmc network.
etmc.join.already: Leave the current etmc network first (etmc menu → Session status → Leave network).
etmc.join.already.title: Already in an etmc network
etmc.join.bad_link: It couldn't be read (%s). Ask the host to copy it again.
etmc.join.bad_link.title: That etmc link doesn't work
etmc.join.hint: Paste the etmc:// link your host shared
etmc.join.in_world: You're in a world: this adds the host to your server list, to join after you leave.
etmc.join.link_bad_relay.title: That etmc link can't reach the host
etmc.join.link_no_relay: It has no relay, so there's no way to reach the host. Ask the host to add a relay in etmc Settings and copy the link again.
etmc.join.no_world: etmc reached the host, but no world answered on port %s. They may have closed it or stopped hosting: ask them to host again and send you the new link.
etmc.join.no_world.title: The host's world isn't open
etmc.join.not_a_link: That isn't an etmc link (%s). Copy it from the host again.
etmc.join.progress.address: Reached the network — getting an address…
etmc.join.progress.host: Reached the network — waiting for the host to show up…
etmc.join.progress.p2p: Host found via the relay — trying for a direct link (%ss)…
etmc.join.progress.world: Host found — checking that their world is open…
etmc.join.start_failed.title: Couldn't start the etmc network
etmc.join.superseded: a newer join replaced this one
etmc.join.title: Join a world
etmc.join.unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the host
etmc.join.why.no_host: The relay answered, but the host (%s) isn't on the network. Make sure they are hosting right now and that the link is from their current session (the network name and secret must match).
etmc.join.why.no_relay: The relay (%s) couldn't be reached. Check your internet connection, and ask the host whether the relay is online.
etmc.lan.failed: Failed to open the world to LAN.
etmc.lan.no_port: Couldn't reserve a local port for Open to LAN.
etmc.link.config_bad_server: the config's server '%s' isn't an IPv4 address and port. Ask the server admin to fix its [etmc] server line
etmc.link.config_no_relay: the config has no relay, so there's no way to reach the server. Ask the server admin to add a [[peer]] line
etmc.link.config_no_server: the config doesn't name a server. Ask the server admin to add an [etmc] server line
etmc.link.config_version: this link needs a newer version of etmc
etmc.link.is_config: this link loads a config from a URL, so it has no details of its own
etmc.link.no_network: etmc link without a network name
etmc.menu.sub.no_native: Native library not loaded — see logs
etmc.menu.sub.no_relay: To host, add a relay in Settings first
etmc.menu.sub.server: You're on a server: only singleplayer worlds can be hosted
etmc.menu.sub.title: Open a singleplayer world to host it, or join someone's

etmc.relay.no_port: '%s' has no port (EasyTier relays usually listen on 11010)
etmc.relay.no_scheme: '%s' has no protocol. Write it like %s
etmc.serverlist.link: etmc invite link: click Join Server to connect
etmc.session.busy_host: etmc is already hosting; leave first
etmc.session.busy_join: etmc is already joined; leave first
etmc.settings.bad_port: %s must be a number from %s to 65535.
etmc.settings.no_overlay: This Minecraft/Forge version has no overlay API, so there is no overlay.
etmc.settings.overlay.unavailable: Top-left status overlay: not available here
etmc.settings.relays.hint: Relays, for hosting (commas or spaces between them)
etmc.settings.title: etmc settings
etmc.status.host_failed: Joiners can't connect any more (%s). Stop hosting and host again.
etmc.status.ip_clash: Another host on this network uses the same address, so joiners may reach the wrong world. Stop and host with a different network name.
etmc.status.link_copied: Invite link copied. It contains the secret: send it only to people you want in.
etmc.status.link_join: Connected directly over the network (%s connection(s))
etmc.status.nothing_to_copy: Nothing to copy: the session ended.
etmc.status.peers.none_host: nobody yet — share your invite link
etmc.status.relay_waiting: Relay: not reached yet (check its address in Settings and your internet).
etmc.status.title: etmc status
etmc.url.bad_redirect: the server sent a redirect etmc won't follow
etmc.url.field.hint: Config URL (http/https to an EasyTier config)
etmc.url.https_only: this link must use https://. Use Connect via config URL for http://
etmc.url.private: this link can't load from a private address (%s). Use Connect via config URL instead
etmc.url.server.hint: Server ip:port (optional if config has [etmc] server)
etmc.url.timeout: the server took too long to send the config
